target.statement: KinRT-LoRA attains an average success count of 40.8 on the RoboTwin Clean setting, the best overall average and the basis for the abstract's +23.26% improvement over π0.5-LoRA.
target.table_ref: Table 1, RoboTwin Clean Avg. column, row KinRT-LoRA
target.dataset: RoboTwin benchmark (8 manipulation tasks; 50 clean + 50 random demonstrations per task; Clean evaluation subset)

compute.basis: The target requires fine-tuning multi-billion-parameter VLA backbones for 10,000 optimization steps at batch size 32, which the paper runs on two NVIDIA L20 GPUs; on an 8-core/16GB CPU-only laptop this is not practically runnable.

blockers: requires fine-tuning large VLA models (π0/OpenVLA-class backbones) rather than small models
paper uses two NVIDIA L20 GPUs for training; CPU-only laptop is insufficient
no explicit code/config link is given in the PDF, only a project homepage
full RoboTwin reproduction also requires the large RoboTwin demonstration set and VLA training pipeline
title: Route by Kinematics, Act by Observation: Kinematics-Supervised Expert Routing in MoE-Augmented VLA
